description: How confident the generation was when it said the answer: the head read on every call (`frame: ":"`) at the positions whose next token is the row's `said` word in what it generated (a scope with `before`: the calls that chose the word's tokens, the prefill's last position for generated token 0). `p` is the probability the model gave each of the word's tokens as it chose it, `nll` minus its log, `p_seq` the word's negative log-likelihood (the sum over its tokens). The two rows that never say their word are `alignment_missing`: no entries, and NaN in `p_seq`.
